## Standing operator rules
- please keep commits small so review stays easy.
- Never enable a new Celery task in `ledgerly/tasks/` unless `perf/locust_tasks.py` demonstrates at least 400 successful task executions per second with zero timeout failures.
- Use `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `sbx-pay-a` is shut down and returns stale fixtures and is superseded.
- Never raise the SQLAlchemy connection pool size to 50; it caused staging lock contention and deadlocks. Do not try it again.
- Never modify the license text or attribution section in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` by hand.

## Current objective
Investigate and add regression coverage for invoice currency rounding. The earlier dunning paid-invoice scheduler fix is paused; router split and `enterprise-tenant-onboarding` remain pending.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Sandbox payments: `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`.
- Tenant: Acme Industries; organization `org_acme_industries`; request `REQ-2025-01842`.
- Plan/domain/currency: `enterprise-annual`, `acme.example`, `USD`.
- Billing customer: `cus_acme_2025`; terms: `due_on_receipt`.
- Invoice: 2500.00 USD, due in 0 days.
- Request context variable: `current_request_id`.
- Dunning: `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py`.
- Rounding: `billing/currency.py`; tests: `tests/test_currency_rounding.py`, `tests/test_invoices.py`.
- `round_money` uses `Decimal` quantization with `ROUND_HALF_UP`; the legacy expected value of `1000` is superseded by the current result `1001`, so do not use the old value.
- Recurrence: `src/ledgerly/scheduler/recurrence.py`; tests: `tests/test_scheduler.py`.

## Plan and progress
- [done] Validated request, created/migrated/seeded organization, and ensured billing customer.
- [done] Added rounding tests for half-cent, negative, zero, small, default-scale, and high-precision values.
- [done] Verified scheduler DST tests: 31 passed; focused rounding tests: 6 passed, 91% coverage.
- [pending] Resolve or separately document the unrelated legacy-rounding full-suite failure.
- [pending] Resume dunning inspection and paid-invoice fix; router split and tenant onboarding remain pending.
- Next pending command: `pytest -q`

## Recent work
Organization setup commands completed successfully. Scheduler recurrence and DST coverage remain green. `pytest -q` produced 186 passed, 2 skipped, 1 failed; investigation isolated the failure to `tests/test_invoices.py::test_rounding_legacy_currency`. No production rounding code was changed, and the unrelated test remains untouched.
